name: Rechargeable Blackhead Remover Vacuum Cleaner | Model FPLS-001 | Deep Pore Cleansing & Microdermabrasion Device
description:
Achieve a cleaner and smoother-looking complexion with this Rechargeable Blackhead Remover Vacuum Cleaner. Designed to help remove surface oil, dirt, and blackheads, this compact skincare device features multiple interchangeable suction heads and adjustable suction levels for customized facial cleansing. Its ergonomic, rechargeable design makes it convenient for regular skincare routines at home or while traveling.

Key Features
Helps remove blackheads, excess oil, and surface impurities
Features 6 interchangeable suction heads for different skincare needs
Includes 3 adjustable suction levels for customized use
Helps gently exfoliate and improve the appearance of skin texture
USB rechargeable design for convenient use
Compact, lightweight, and easy-to-hold design
Suitable for use on different areas of the face
Includes scraping and cupping functions for skincare routines
Made from durable ABS material
Suitable for normal, oily, and combination skin with appropriate suction settings

Product Specifications
Product Type: Rechargeable Blackhead Remover Vacuum Cleaner
Model: FPLS-001
Power: 2.5W
Suction Levels: 3 Adjustable Levels
Suction Heads: 6 Interchangeable Heads

How to Use
Cleanse your face before using the device
Apply a warm towel for a few minutes if desired
Select a suitable suction head and suction level
Test the suction on a small area first
Gently move the device across the skin without holding it in one spot
Do not leave the suction head on one area for more than 2 seconds
Clean the device and suction heads after use
Apply a soothing moisturizer or skincare product afterward

Material / Composition
ABS Plastic Body
Electronic Vacuum Suction System
Rechargeable Battery
Interchangeable Skincare Suction Heads

Safety Information
For external skincare use only
Perform a patch or sensitivity test before first use
Do not use on broken, irritated, or damaged skin
Avoid using excessive suction pressure
Do not keep the device in one position for an extended time
Stop use if excessive redness, irritation, or discomfort occurs
Keep out of reach of children
Store in a cool, dry place

Package Includes
1 × Rechargeable Blackhead Remover Vacuum Cleaner
6 × Interchangeable Suction Heads
1 × Android charging cable
